key_insight: An AI cell-boundary overlay showed promise for more consistent interpretation of neurologic autoantibody assays, not cancer drug discovery.
clinical_relevance: The combined overlay and model category may support second-read review, but clinical utility requires independent validation.
method: Transfer detected cell boundaries from the structural channel onto antibody-staining images.
Compare model classifications with a reader-derived three-class reference.
Have four readers assess held-out records first unassisted, then with the overlay and model category.
evidence_signal: Using 2,763 development records and 499 held-out records across 14 antibody targets, the selected model achieved 85.2% reference agreement; reader agreement increased with assistance.
watch_item: Recall was lowest for weak-positive or equivocal records, and nearly all revised reader ratings shifted toward the model category, raising anchoring concerns.
paper_title: AI-Assisted Interpretation of Neurologic Autoantibody Cell-Based Assays
